ip_datacenter_anchor_check.name: ip_datacenter_anchor_check
ip_datacenter_anchor_check.value:
(
        "ip"."datacenter_id" IS NULL OR
        ("ip"."server_id" IS NULL AND "ip"."network_id" IS NULL) OR
        "ip"."server_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

ip_datacenter_member_network_check.name: ip_datacenter_member_network_check
ip_datacenter_member_network_check.value:
(
        "ip"."scope" <> 'datacenter' OR
        "ip"."server_id" IS NULL OR
        "ip"."network_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

managed_status_check.name: managed_status_check
managed_status_check.value: status IS NULL OR status IN ('provisioning','applying','ready','stopped','failed')

network_single_scope_check.name: network_single_scope_check
network_single_scope_check.value:
(
        ("network"."kind" = 'datacenter' AND "network"."datacenter_id" IS NOT NULL AND "network"."server_id" IS NULL AND "network"."environment_id" IS NULL AND "network"."cidr" IS NOT NULL) OR
        ("network"."kind" = 'docker' AND "network"."datacenter_id" IS NULL AND "network"."environment_id" IS NULL) OR
        ("network"."kind" = 'compose' AND "network"."datacenter_id" IS NULL AND "network"."server_id" IS NULL)
      )

node_status_check.name: node_status_check
node_status_check.value: status IS NULL OR status IN ('provisioning','applying','ready','stopped','failed','needs_resync')

uniq_storage_environment_compose_volume_.name: uniq_storage_environment_compose_volume_key
uniq_storage_environment_compose_volume_.where:
kind = 'volume'
          AND environment_id IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(metadata->>'composeVolumeKey', '') <> ''

storage_at_most_one_parent_check.name: storage_at_most_one_parent_check
storage_at_most_one_parent_check.value:
((workspace_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (project_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (environment_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (service_id IS NOT NULL)::int) <= 1

tls_ca_state_check.name: tls_ca_state_check
tls_ca_state_check.value: ca_state IS NULL OR ca_state IN ('active', 'retired', 'revoked')

tls_ca_lifecycle_source_check.name: tls_ca_lifecycle_source_check
tls_ca_lifecycle_source_check.value: (source = 'organization_ca' AND ca_state IS NOT NULL) OR (source <> 'organization_ca' AND ca_state IS NULL AND ca_generation IS NULL)

tls_ca_generation_required_check.name: tls_ca_generation_required_check
tls_ca_generation_required_check.value: ca_state IS NULL OR ca_state = 'revoked' OR ca_generation IS NOT NULL

tls_leaf_kind_keys_check.name: tls_leaf_kind_keys_check
tls_leaf_kind_keys_check.value:
(
        ("tlsleaf"."kind" = 'ingress' AND "tlsleaf"."node_id" IS NULL AND "tlsleaf"."managed_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("tlsleaf"."kind" = 'engine' AND "tlsleaf"."node_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tlsleaf"."managed_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

variable_exactly_one_parent_check.name: variable_exactly_one_parent_check
variable_exactly_one_parent_check.value:
((organization_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (workspace_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (project_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (environment_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (service_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (hosting_id IS NOT NULL)::int +
        (server_id IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1
